_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex (su móvil), capítulo 1 tal como es HOY (outside). Formato y reglas en qa/README.md § Diario. Condiciones con la gramática de `when` de A2.6a: flag, !flag, item:id, !item:id; lista = todas. Se reescribe en A3.3.

goals.text: Find the code for Adrian's front door.
Check Adrian's mail. Nosy is a job description.
Search the porch for anything Adrian hid.

notes.text: Behind the porch light: a note, ACCESS CODE 7314. Who hides the code next to the door? Someone who wants it found.
Mailbox: a sealed envelope, 'CONFIDENTIAL — PATIENT ZERO'. Somebody important will want to see this.
Adrian's Ledger was under the doormat. A hardware wallet under a doormat. Bold strategy.

hints: Moths know where the light is. So should you.
Something is tucked behind the porch light.
Pick up the porch light. Read the note.
You have numbers. Doors like numbers.
The keypad. The note. Introduce them.
Use the code note on the keypad.
